name: Wyoming Android TTS
tagline: Use your Android's TTS engines in Home Assistant via the Wyoming protocol.
blurb: Use your Android device's Text-to-Speech (TTS) engines in Home Assistant.
description:
Use your Android device's Text-to-Speech (TTS) engines in Home Assistant.

This app acts as a Wyoming protocol server, allowing you to use any TTS engine installed on your Android phone or tablet—including Google's offline voices.

To use it, install the app, start the server, and add the "Wyoming Android TTS" service to the Wyoming integration in Home Assistant.
